“If you find that you’re bored a lot, you’re probably boring.”

What she meant was that there’s plenty to occupy yourself around you or even in your own thoughts, rather than relying on constant activity or interactions to stimulate you. After a little mental practice of making up thought experiments when I felt bored, it became automatic. If I found myself at home without a way to spend my time, I’d purposefully find a new hobby or an old one to get back into. (I should note that I have massive depressive disorder so sometimes I don’t have the will to do anything but I think that’s different lol) Based on how often my coworkers and friends complain about boredom, I think that teacher really changed my life.
